title: Post-hoc corrections and spatial FDR
text: running group-level analysis, typically one p-value per spatial unit (voxel, parcel, ROI). Testing thousands locations simultaneously inflates false positives, need multiple comparison correction. Standard FDR (Benjamini–Hochberg) treats every test independently. Spatial FDR goes grouping spatially related tests—instance, voxels within parcel—adjusting within across groups better control false discovery rate structured neuroimaging data. vignette shows apply standard spatial FDR corrections fmrigds, including chain operations realized GDS objects.

text: GDS (Group Data Set) fmrigds’s core data structure. organises first-level fMRI outputs along three axes: Samples (rows): spatial units measured—voxels, parcels, ROIs, latent components. Subjects (columns): participants study. text: examine_group() branches subject-level prefix analysis. uses reducer’s frozen formula, estimands, variance rules, subject order report three different questions: whether data validity concern, whether subject unexpected fitted model, much deleting subject changes requested group statistic. change analysis classify subjects removal. review queue uses absolute, stability-aware gates. percentile-based review_priority orders inspection. random-effects models, first pass holds full-data heterogeneity estimate fixed; retained subjects receive exact refits, modes recorded result. See vignette("group-examination") result contract, availability states, interpretation plots.
code: analysis <- gds(paths, col_data = participants) |>   subset(contrast = c("faces>places", "tools>faces")) |>   reduce(     method = "meta:re_reg",     formula = ~ group + age + sex + site   ) |>   posthoc("fdr:bh")  exam <- examine_group(   analysis,   estimands = "grouppatient",   quality = c("mean_fd", "tsnr") )  plot(exam)                         # surprise versus influence plot(exam, type = "embedding")    # model-adjusted residual geometry plot(exam, subject = "sub-017")   # retained subject maps write_report(exam, "group-examination.html")  fit <- compute(analysis)

title: fmrigds 0.1.0.9000
text: Added fit_group() bounded feature-block fitting directly aligned fmridataset estimate sampling-variance assays. Added serializable, metadata-group_plan() objects reducer-registry frame kernels. Random-intercept known-variance voxelwise OLS reducers now share one bounded frame execution path, including explicit observation-ID mapping design-row omission featurewise missing-data handling. walking-skeleton model supports ragged random-intercept designs, preserves feature IDs spatial identity result fmri_frame, numerically checked metafor::rma.mv().

title: fmrigds 0.1.0.9000
text: Added examine_group() terminal branch subject-level plans. reports data validity, cross-fitted model surprise, deletion influence named estimands, model-adjusted residual geometry without changing source analysis. Added exact fixed-effect, meta-regression, voxelwise OLS diagnostics, plus fixed-tau2 random-effects screening exact retained-subject refits. Added deterministic block scanning staging, action-plane drill-plots, selected post-hoc sensitivity analyses, self-contained HTML reports. Corrected DerSimonian-Laird meta-regression denominator use tr(W - W X (X' W X)^-1 X' W) aligned R/C++ variance-validity rules. Hardened CI pkgdown provisioning GitHub-neuroim2, neurotabs, neurothresh development dependencies.

title: fmrigds 0.1.0.9000
text: write_nifti_assays() write_out(format = "nifti") now preserve input spatial affine (spacing, origin, orientation) write scl_slope = 1 3D outputs, instead emitting identity NeuroSpace. Exported group maps now geometrically correct without manual re-stamp (#6). ols:voxelwise (therefore one_sample()/group_ols()) now applies per-sample listwise deletion non-finite subjects: single NaN subject longer poisons voxel -NaN subject longer poisons whole map. Samples finite observations returned NA, new n_obs assay reports effective sample size, summary warning emitted sample reduced (#7). one_sample() / group_ols(~ 1) now build intercept-design automatically longer require col_data (#1). Variance-weighted reducers (fixed/random/meta:*, weights = "1/var" reduction) now error actionable message applied beta-GDS whose var assay synthetic unit-variance placeholder, rather silently producing meaningless group standard errors (#5). Documented reducer output assay names (reduce() ols:voxelwise topic), single-contrast scope gds_from_nifti_maps(), filename pairing contract nifti_source(beta=, se=) (#2, #3, #4).

title: fmrigds 0.1.0.9000
text: Added restricted repeated-measures Gaussian LMM reducers: lmm:ri lmm:ri_slope1. Added variance-aware lmm:ri_knownvar lmm:ri_slope1_knownvar reducers. fit diag(var) + vc_resid * + Z G Z', reject synthetic nonpositive variances, numerically checked metafor::rma.mv(). Added theta_mode = "pooled" theta_mode = "voxelwise" shared- vs sample-specific variance parameters. Added long-table repeated-measures ingestion via contrast_data_cols, contrast metadata can extracted directly tabular sources. Hardened low-rank LMM kernels numerical asymmetry intermediate SPD matrices. Expanded mixed-model tests cover lme4 parity, pooled/voxelwise equivalence identical responses, sample-specific theta recovery. Added dedicated repeated-measures vignette reducer-specific documentation supported LMM contract. Added CI coverage lme4-backed restricted LMM parity tests plus scheduled benchmark workflow. Warm-started voxelwise theta optimization pooled previous-sample fits reduce repeated optimizer cold starts.

title: fmrigds 0.1.0.9000
text: Added -memory tabular support: gds(<data.frame>) now works via tabular adapter (temporary files needed). Added roi_col alias tabular ingestion treat ROI/parcel labels sample axis.
